debug.description: Enable verbose output for debugging. Corresponds to the --debug flag in rsop(1).

default_subcommand.description: The default subcommand to run. Valid values: version, verify, inline-verify, generate-key, change-key-password, revoke-key, extract-cert, update-key, merge-certs, certify-userid, validate-userid, sign, encrypt, decrypt, armor, dearmor, inline-detach, inline-sign.

default_key_path.description: Filesystem path to the secret keyring used by cryptographic operations.

default_format.description: Default data format (binary or armored) for encryption/decryption/armor operations.
